Same session, same data, data-product=bhd-erp, 325-326 wave rules deleted vs present: /customer 0 of 5,184,000 differing px, /invoice 0 of 5,184,000, mobile dashboard 0 of 1,316,640. Desktop dashboard 9,778 of 5,184,000 (0.19%) confined to css x754-905 y813-899, the donut; the CONTROL pair (two identical ON captures, nothing toggled) differs by 1,134,439 px (21.9%) over that same region, so the A/B sits two orders of magnitude inside the page's own animation noise floor. Chart nondeterminism, exempt. A first /customer run reported 454,460 px: I cropped it and it was three stacked 'Too many requests. Please slow down.' rate-limit toasts my own capture loop had triggered, sitting over the OFF shot; suppressed and re-run with 20s spacing it is 0. The three modified JSX files are NOT covered by a CSS kill, so I checked them separately: every changed branch is behind module-scope IS_PNP / productKey==='pnp' read from the same source RootApp uses, and under the real bhd-erp key BHD renders waveNodes=0 and .wave-brand=null on dashboard and /customer at both viewports. Against the stored baseline-*.png the numbers are large (2,437,472 / 307,478 / 952,900 / 596,903) but that is stale-baseline data drift: the same surfaces are byte-identical with the wave CSS wholly deleted, and the /customer figure reproduces r6's and r7's 307,861 across three independent rounds while the CSS changed substantially between them. So the verdict is design, and this round ours takes it. All three of r7's measured failures are fixed and I re-measured each. (1) Topbar void 62.0% -> 0.4%: the header is 1364px and first ink is now at x=82, a 'Paper & Pen' wordmark landing on the rail mark's baseline across the rail/topbar seam. Controls down from eight to six plus the search field, and the stray 'English' text label is gone from desktop. (2) The rail's active state on the FRONT DOOR: on / there is now exactly ONE tinted item, 'Dashboard', rgba(43,87,216,0.11) on a real 42x42 box at y=121, and the Favorites container carries nothing. On /customer the one painted pill is on Customers. The r2-through-r7 Favorites confusion is gone. (3) KPI ink: 11 of 11 figures now render rgb(16,24,40) at 800 weight, one colour; the green-0.000-here red-0.000-there split is gone. r4's guillotine is also dead: the expanded rail is 268px fixed z-1000 and its box-shadow now computes to rgba(16,24,40,0.14) 18px 0 48px, so occluded content reads as a layer beneath rather than a hairline cut. What ours actually wins on, like for like: the #f5f9ff ground, the single white rounded container with a soft border and no drop shadow, the icon-only 76px rail with blue glyphs and a pale-blue rounded-square pill, the Plus Jakarta geometric sans headings (the bar's hardest call, and the one most ports get wrong), and a list table that is at least the bar's equal, pale grey header in sentence case, no vertical rules, no zebra, no card per row, generous rows, bold near-black primary against muted grey secondary, thin separators only. On top of that ours carries structure the bar never shows: a sectioned rail, a breadcrumb, and a coherent mobile bottom tab bar. Residual, and it is genuinely smaller than anything previous rounds rejected on: a 24px grey button whose own aria-label is 'Interface sound off', drawn as a speaker-with-a-slash, permanently in the chrome of a financial app and reading as a broken or muted state; a red '15' bell badge that is the loudest pixel in the shell where the bar's chrome has no red at all; a globe paired with the text 'EN' on mobile, an icon and a word in the same run; and a lock FAB overlapping the Revenue card at 390px. Two things I discounted with evidence rather than assertion: the BHD mark beside 'Paper & Pen' is the local dev tenant's own logoUrl from /api/tenant/branding, i.e. data, and the beach orb bottom-right is TanStack devtools behind import.meta.env.DEV. One honest limitation: DataTable's PRODUCT_KEY is module-scope, so the prescribed force-after-load capture does not run its money-column fitting or uniform-column classes; my shots therefore UNDERSTATE ours, and those are table-piece concerns, not shell. I also could not verify what Wave puts at the right of its own header, because the bar PNG is a marketing crop that cuts off mid-'What's ne[w]' -- so I compared only what is actually visible in it rather than inventing an empty right edge.
